1114.panicDescription:
攻击等级+5，防御等级+5
Offense Level +5, Defense Level +5
1114.flavor:
全是些不认识的话。只是从某个地方，突然就出现了。
自顾自地浮现，又自顾自地刻下……全是外面来的、听起来像那么回事的话。我根本不知道这些话是什么意思。

……即便如此，我也明白了。
I don't know any of these words. They just... came from somewhere.
They pop into my head on their own. They get stuck in there on their own. They're all just fancy-sounding words that came from outside. I don't really know what any of them mean.

... But somehow, I get it...

1118.panicName: 黑神-黑派的巨人-神父-锤子派
1118.flavor:
西西弗系统内的时间不受物质阻力影响，以极快的速度流逝。但巨人们能借各自的观点，与系统内的时间同步，从而拥有与客户交流的时间。

其中，代表锤子派的巨人可以控制系统内的记忆与时间，并独自决定重置部分库存。
Time passes at a tremendous pace within the Sisyphe System, unhindered by material resistance. Yet through their respective viewpoints, the Giants can synchronize themselves with the System's internal flow of time and communicate with its customers.

Among them, the Giant who represents the Hammers holds authority over the System's internal memories and time, with the power to reset portions of its inventory at his own discretion.

1122.panicDescription:
基础威力-1，造成的伤害-10%
Base Power -1, deal -10% damage
1122.flavor:
对世界的作呕与恶心。这个世界仅仅是存在着。一切都没有意义，不过是偶然的产物，被摆在眼前而已。

只是偶然。一切都是。
Revulsion. Nausea before the world. The world simply exists. Nothing in it bears any inherent meaning; everything before our eyes is merely the product of chance.

Everything is a contingency. Everything.
